channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 25
item.description:
66 development commits

Combat & Weapon Balance

  • Radwater now deals significant damage to fully equipped kits, with damage scaling using protection values and interacting with sprinklers.
  • Flashlight toggles on/off with right‑click, includes new animations, sound events, tooltip updates, and extinguishes on sleep or disconnect.
  • Semi‑automatic pistol damage now falls off more sharply at range, and its high‑quality metal crafting cost increased to six.
  • HAB vehicle and attack helicopter armor colliders corrected and made unique, improving client/server collision handling.
  • Weapon spawn probabilities adjusted: SMG bodies are now more common while rifle bodies are less common, improving mid‑game balance.

AI & Navigation

  • Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships fixed, improving AI pathing on those vessels.
  • AI units no longer flee when the player jumps, reducing unwanted retreats.

UI, Economy & Quality of Life

  • Session/connect modal overflow fixed (description scroll works and modal can be closed) and launch siren off‑state now visible, improving UI clarity.
  • Store UI upgraded to support dynamic sprites and pages, layout issues resolved, and now displays sale information with new Sell Animals panels that list nearby livestock and preview rewards.

Comfort & Performance

  • Bear rugs and regular rugs now provide 100 % comfort within 2 m (bear) or 1 m (regular) radius, with gradual falloff to 3 m/2 m, enhancing base comfort.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 24
item.description:
68 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, and longsword swings have a larger 0.4 radius with a faster 1.5‑second delay for more accurate attacks.
  • SAM sites fire proximity‑fuse missiles at drones, target 2.25× faster, can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and a new setting lets servers adjust the drone detonation distance.
  • Homing launchers now show a “Keep on target” label and their lock‑on timer is 30 % shorter.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 23
item.description:
20 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Fixed missing navmesh on Ghost Ship A, restoring proper AI navigation.

Items & Inventory

  • Reduced beancan stack size from 5 to 4.

Equipment

  • Heavy plate helmet now muffles game audio when equipped.

Fuel & Dome

  • Capped dome fuel pump crude storage to 1000 per pump.
